improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
improve.coach: 43% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
improve.coach: It's come up in 43% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
improve.coach: 60% of your last five, up from 36% overall. Time to put this one front and center.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Never gets old, and I hope it never does. 57% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it. 43% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

coach.intro: Alright tuxedo_slide, 14 matches in. Let's talk patterns, the good and the growing.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
